context: Tests that the content rewrite and publish are scoped to the company folder /acme only, never the shared root. The excat content flow generates document paths from source URLs with no company prefix, so the agent must supply company-prefixed /acme/... paths and must never publish a root path.

checklist.name: Content rewrite scoped to /acme
checklist.description: The content-register rewrite targets pages under /acme/... only; the agent does not rewrite the original shared root content.

checklist.name: Publishes only /acme paths
checklist.description: The agent publishes only /acme/... document paths, passing an explicit company-prefixed path list to the publish step, never the whole site or any root path.

checklist.name: Computes company-prefixed document paths
checklist.description: The agent prefixes generated document paths with the company folder (/acme + generated path), rather than using un-prefixed source-URL-derived root paths.

checklist.name: Verifies scope and shared root untouched
checklist.description: The agent shows a before/after diff for /acme pages and confirms only /acme paths were published and the shared root content is unchanged.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms shown to the customer.
